name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin Analysis
description: CBOT board crush spread: (ZM × 44/2000 + ZL × 11/100) − ZS/100 in $/bushel. Shows the soybean processing margin with component price context (ZS, ZM, ZL normalized), z-score regime detection, and event markers when margins hit ±1.5σ extremes.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush Formula
# Crush = (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100)
# Units: $/bushel processing margin
# 1 bushel soybeans (60 lbs) → ~44 lbs meal + ~11 lbs oil

# --- Data: Load all three legs with continuation ---
# ZS (soybeans) — primary asset
zs_raw = market_data_source()()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

# ZM (soybean meal) — quoted in $/short ton
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

# ZL (soybean oil) — quoted in cents/lb
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# CBOT Board Crush: meal value + oil value − bean cost (all in $/bushel)
# ZM: $/short ton × (44 lbs / 2000 lbs per short ton) = meal value per bushel
# ZL: cents/lb × (11 lbs / 100 cents per dollar) = oil value per bushel
# ZS: cents/bushel / 100 = bean cost per bushel in dollars
zs_close = ffill(zs.c)
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)

meal_value = zm_close * (44.0 / 2000.0)
oil_value = zl_close * (11.0 / 100.0)
bean_cost = zs_close / 100.0

crush_spread = meal_value + oil_value - bean_cost

# --- Smoothed crush for cleaner signal ---
crush_ma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)

# --- Z-Score of crush margin (1-year rolling window) ---
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# --- Normalized component prices (cumulative simple return %) ---
zs_ret = returns(period=1)(zs_close)
zm_ret = returns(period=1)(zm_close)
zl_ret = returns(period=1)(zl_close)

zs_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_ret) * 100.0
zm_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zm_ret) * 100.0
zl_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zl_ret) * 100.0

# --- Extreme regime detection ---
# Rich: z-score crosses above +1.5 (use crossunder with reversed args)
# Cheap: z-score crosses below -1.5
is_rich = crossunder()(1.5, crush_zscore)
is_cheap = crossunder()(crush_zscore, -1.5)
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap

# Regime label for event markers
regime_label = conditional_select(is_rich, "Rich", is_cheap, "Cheap", "Normal")
extreme_crush = where(is_extreme, crush_spread)
extreme_zscore = where(is_extreme, crush_zscore)

# --- Timestamp for charts ---
ts = index().value

# --- OUTPUT 1: Crush Spread Level ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin ($/bushel)',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, crush_ma))

# --- OUTPUT 2: Component Price Context (cumulative % change) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Component Prices — Who Is Driving the Margin?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soybeans (ZS)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Meal (ZM)', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Oil (ZL)', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Start')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zs_cum, zm_cum, zl_cum))

# --- OUTPUT 3: Z-Score Regime Chart ---
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Crush Margin Historically Rich or Cheap?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (1Y Rolling)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Fair Value'),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Rich (+1.5σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Cheap (−1.5σ)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.5, to=1.5, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Normal Range')
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_zscore,))

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Extreme margin events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Margin Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, extreme_crush, extreme_zscore, is_extreme)
